### Giving While You’re Living
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-december-17-2020.html
Passage: 2 Corinthians 12:14
Points:
- Parents are called to provide for their children rather than burdening them.
- Sharing wealth with children while still alive brings contentment and removes future guilt.
- Abraham modeled this wisdom by establishing his sons with provisions before his death.
- Releasing financial resources during life allows believers to witness the blessing firsthand.

### Marks of an Excellent Shepherd: Selflessness
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/print/B130311/marks-of-an-excellent-shepherd-selflessness
Passage: 2 Corinthians 12:12-19
Points:
- True spiritual shepherds demonstrate selflessness rather than exploiting followers for personal gain.
- Paul proved his pastoral integrity by refusing financial compensation so he would not burden the Corinthians.
- A godly minister seeks the people's spiritual growth and hearts rather than their possessions.
- Following Christ's example, faithful leaders gladly expend themselves and their resources to serve the church.
